manual_review_reason: RTRFM exposes an official form with a validation honeypot, personal-data fields, a biography upload and free stream/download-link requirements. A human must leave the anti-spam field untouched, approve the bio and links, confirm file access and rights, decide whether to use the form or the protected first-party email route, and keep optional physical delivery separate.

FBi Radio requires a human-written email pitch, a stream link and a free high-quality download link, with timing around its Wednesday audition process. A human must approve the subject line, biography, press image, release context, non-expiring file access and suitability for a general or specialist program while recognizing the station’s Sydney and Australian programming priority.

PBS explicitly presents a human-verification CAPTCHA and an anti-spam field that must remain blank. A human must complete the form, approve personal details, biography, social and gig information, verify the stream and 320 kbps-or-better download link, decline or accept the optional newsletter separately, and decide whether optional physical copies are appropriate.
